agent.problem: Card 1 has already named Maacah daughter of Abishalom as Abijam's mother, and this card explicitly asks the baker to recall that name. The earlier story card therefore gives away the answer to this later choice card.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

rule.text: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly.
